description: Semantic documentation consistency rules that supplement Markdown link/path checks without claiming runtime provider readiness.

routeReference.description: Backticked API route references in Markdown must resolve to a Next.js route.ts handler in the web or dashboard app, unless explicitly listed as an external/provider URL.

providerReadinessLanguage.description: Provider documentation may describe contracts, placeholders, sandbox plans, or blocked work, but must not claim live readiness without evidence-oriented language.

legalReadinessLanguage.description: Legal/privacy/security documentation may include templates and workflows, but legal completion claims must remain evidence-gated until counsel review is recorded.
